stem: Zane wants to add some questions after sentence 25 to help close this paper. Which of the following could best be added after sentence 25?

options.label: F
options.text: But what about 20 or 30 years from now? Could robotics provide treatments that are unheard of today?

options.label: G
options.text: What is technology used for today? How will it be used when you are an adult?

options.label: H
options.text: Are there places that are too remote to get a connection? Are there people who don't even have access to a computer?

options.label: J
options.text: Does your computer always work? Can you depend on technology when you need it?
